deleted_or_nonpayable_cpt.99201: Deleted by AMA CPT effective January 1, 2021; report 99202-99205 based on MDM or total time.
deleted_or_nonpayable_cpt.99343: Deleted by AMA CPT effective January 1, 2023; report 99341, 99342, 99344, or 99345.
deleted_or_nonpayable_cpt.99324: Domiciliary/ALF codes 99324-99337 were deleted effective January 1, 2023; report Home or Residence Services 99341-99350 with POS 13 (ALF).
deleted_or_nonpayable_cpt.99242: Outpatient consultation codes (99242-99245) are NOT payable by Medicare Part B (CR 6740 / MLN MM6740); bill 99202-99215 or 99341-99350.
deleted_or_nonpayable_cpt.99252: Inpatient/SNF consultation codes (99252-99255) are NOT payable by Medicare Part B (CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 12, § 30.6.13 / MLN MM6740); for SNF consults, bill Initial Nursing Facility Care 99304-99306 without Modifier -AI.

25.name: Significant, Separately Identifiable E/M Service by Same Physician/QHP on Same Day of Procedure
25.rule: Append ONLY to the E/M code (never the procedure code) when a distinct E/M above the pre-/post-work of a same-day minor surgical procedure (0- or 10-day global, e.g., 17000, 20610) is documented. Do NOT append for diagnostic radiology (70000s) or clinical labs (80000s). Blocks G2211 payment unless paired with an exempt Part B preventive service.
25.citation: AMA CPT 2026 Appendix A; CMS NCCI Policy Manual Ch. 1 § E

59.name: Distinct Procedural Service
59.rule: Modifier of last resort to bypass NCCI PTP Column 1/Column 2 bundling (when Modifier Indicator = 1). CMS instructs billers to prefer specific X{EPSU} subset modifiers whenever applicable.
59.citation: CMS MLN Matters SE1418; CMS NCCI Policy Manual Ch. 1 § E

XE.name: Separate Encounter
XE.rule: NCCI specific subset of -59: service occurred during a separate, distinct patient encounter on the same date of service.

XS.name: Separate Structure
XS.rule: NCCI specific subset of -59: service performed on a separate organ or anatomical structure.

XP.name: Separate Practitioner
XP.rule: NCCI specific subset of -59: service performed by a different practitioner.

XU.name: Unusual Non-Overlapping Service
XU.rule: NCCI specific subset of -59: service does not overlap usual components of the main procedure.

24.name: Unrelated E/M Service by Same Physician/QHP During a Postoperative Global Period
24.rule: Appended to an E/M code during a 10- or 90-day global surgical period when the visit is completely unrelated to the original surgery.
24.citation: AMA CPT 2026 Appendix A; CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 12, § 40.2

57.name: Decision for Surgery
57.rule: Appended to an E/M code when the visit results in the initial decision to perform a major surgical procedure (90-day global) on the day before or day of surgery. Never use on 0- or 10-day minor procedures (use -25).
57.citation: AMA CPT 2026 Appendix A; CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 12, § 40.2

AI.name: Principal Physician of Record
AI.rule: Appended strictly to Initial Inpatient or Initial Nursing Facility Care (99304-99306) by the admitting/attending physician overseeing the overall stay. Consulting specialists (e.g., PM&R consultants) MUST NOT append Modifier -AI.
AI.citation: CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 12, § 30.6.13; MLN Matters MM6740

FS.name: Split (or Shared) Evaluation and Management Visit
FS.rule: Appended to facility E/M visits jointly performed by a physician and NPP in the same group; billed under the practitioner who performed >50% of total time or the substantive portion of MDM.
FS.citation: CMS CY2024/CY2026 MPFS Final Rule; 42 CFR § 415.140

GV.name: Attending Physician Not Employed or Paid Under Arrangement by Patient's Hospice Provider
GV.rule: Required on Medicare Part B professional claims when an independent attending physician treats a hospice-enrolled beneficiary for a condition related to the terminal illness.

GW.name: Service Not Related to the Hospice Patient's Terminal Condition
GW.rule: Required on Medicare Part B professional claims when any physician/QHP treats a hospice-enrolled beneficiary for a condition unrelated to the terminal prognosis.

QW.name: CLIA Waived Test
QW.rule: Appended to FDA/CMS CLIA-waived clinical laboratory CPT codes performed by a practice holding a Certificate of Waiver.
QW.citation: CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 16, § 70.8; 42 CFR Part 493

95.name: Synchronous Telemedicine Service Rendered Via Real-Time Interactive Audio and Video
95.rule: Appended to eligible CPT E/M services delivered via real-time interactive audio-video telecommunications; pair with POS 02 (facility/non-home) or POS 10 (patient's home).
95.citation: AMA CPT 2026 Appendix P; CMS Telehealth Services Guidance 2025/2026

93.name: Synchronous Telemedicine Service Rendered Via Telephone or Other Real-Time Interactive Audio-Only
93.rule: Appended to CMS/AMA eligible audio-only telehealth services when video is unavailable or patient cannot/declines video use.
93.citation: AMA CPT 2026 Appendix T; CMS CY2025/CY2026 MPFS Telehealth Audio-Only Policy

JW.name: Drug Amount Discarded / Not Administered to Any Patient
JW.rule: Reported on a separate claim line for discarded Part B drug units from a single-dose container.
JW.citation: CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 17, § 40; Social Security Act § 1847A(h)

JZ.name: Zero Drug Amount Discarded / Not Administered to Any Patient
JZ.rule: Mandatory on single-dose container Medicare Part B drug claim lines when NO drug amount was discarded.
JZ.citation: CMS CY2023-CY2026 MPFS Single-Dose Container Policy; MLN MM13056

02.name: Telehealth Provided Other than in Patient's Home
02.rule: Use when patient is located in a hospital, clinic, or Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) during a telehealth visit. Reimbursed at the Medicare facility rate. Loop 2310C required if required by payer.
02.citation: CMS Place of Service Code Set; CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 12, § 190

10.name: Telehealth Provided in Patient's Home
10.rule: Use strictly when the patient is located in their private residence during a telehealth visit. Reimbursed at the higher Medicare non-facility rate.
10.citation: CMS Place of Service Code Set; MLN MM12427 / CY2024-CY2026 MPFS

11.name: Office
11.rule: Physician/group practice office setting. Compatible with 99202-99215; NEVER compatible with Nursing Facility codes 99304-99310 or Home codes 99341-99350.
11.citation: CMS Place of Service Code Set

12.name: Home
12.rule: Patient's private residence. Compatible with Home or Residence E/M 99341-99350.
12.citation: CMS Place of Service Code Set; AMA CPT 2026 Home or Residence Services

13.name: Assisted Living Facility (ALF)
13.rule: Assisted Living Facility. Since CPT 2023 deleted 99324-99337, bill Home or Residence E/M 99341-99350 with POS 13 and emit Loop 2310C (Box 32) Service Facility.
13.citation: AMA CPT 2023-2026 E/M Restructuring; CMS Place of Service Code Set

21.name: Inpatient Hospital
21.rule: Acute inpatient hospital. Incident-To (42 CFR § 410.26) and G2211 are prohibited. Requires Box 18 Admission Date (DTP*435) and Box 32 Facility (Loop 2310C).
21.citation: CMS Place of Service Code Set; CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 26

31.name: Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF — Medicare Part A Covered Stay)
31.rule: Report POS 31 ONLY when the beneficiary is in a covered Medicare Part A SNF stay (days 1-100). Physician/NPP E/M (99304-99310) is excluded from SNF Consolidated Billing and billed to Part B MAC (09102), whereas PT/OT/SLP therapy (97110, 97140), routine labs, and Part B drugs administered in-house are bundled into the SNF's Part A per-diem under Social Security Act § 1888(e) / 42 CFR § 411.15(p). Requires Loop 2310C (Box 32) and DTP*435 Admission Date (Box 18).
31.citation: Social Security Act § 1888(e); 42 CFR § 411.15(p); CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 6 & Ch. 12 § 30.6.13

32.name: Nursing Facility (NF — Non-Part A / Long-Term Care / Exhausted Part A)
32.rule: Report POS 32 when the resident is in a nursing facility WITHOUT an active Medicare Part A SNF stay (long-term custodial stay, Medicaid LTC, or exhausted Part A benefits). Compatible with 99304-99310; Part B SNF Consolidated Billing Part A stay bundle does not apply (except therapy still requires consolidated rules where applicable). Requires Loop 2310C (Box 32).
32.citation: CMS Place of Service Code Set; CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 6 & Ch. 12 § 30.6.13

aprn_pa_rules.fl_autonomous_aprn_statute: Florida Statutes § 464.0123 restricts autonomous APRN practice (without a physician supervisory protocol) strictly to Primary Care (Family Medicine, General Internal Medicine, General Pediatrics). Specialty APRNs (e.g., PM&R, Dermatology, Cardiology) MUST maintain an active Florida Board of Nursing collaborative protocol.
aprn_pa_rules.citation: Social Security Act § 1833(a)(1)(O) (85% NPP rate); 42 CFR § 410.26 (Incident-To prohibited in POS 21/31/32); Florida Statutes § 464.0123

icd10_cm_fy2026_guidelines.specificity_rule: Section I.B.2 & Section I.B.18: Diagnosis codes must be reported to the highest number of characters available (billable leaf node). Category or subcategory headers (e.g., M54.5, E11, S72.14) are invalid under HIPAA 5010.
icd10_cm_fy2026_guidelines.signs_and_symptoms_rule: Section I.B.4 & Section I.B.5: Signs and symptoms (e.g., knee pain M25.561, low back pain M54.50, fatigue R53.83) that are routine/integral to a confirmed definitive diagnosis on the same claim MUST NOT be coded separately.
icd10_cm_fy2026_guidelines.outpatient_uncertain_and_lab_rule: Section III.B & Section IV.H / IV.K: Do NOT code 'rule out', 'suspected', 'probable', or 'questionable' diagnoses on outpatient/physician claims; code the documented symptoms/condition to highest certainty. Never assign a diagnosis (such as Anemia D64.9 or Hyponatremia E87.1) solely from raw abnormal laboratory values without explicit physician clinical interpretation.
icd10_cm_fy2026_guidelines.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting FY2026 (CMS & CDC/NCHS, effective October 1, 2025 - September 30, 2026)

conversions.5-3-2: Prepend leading '0' to 2nd segment (Product): XXXXX-XXX-XX -> XXXXX0XXXXX

fda_ndc_rules.ambiguous_10_digit_rule: An unhyphenated 10-digit string cannot be deterministically padded without FDA directory segment boundaries and must be rejected until hyphenated or verified.
fda_ndc_rules.edi_mapping: X12 837P Loop 2410: LIN**N4*<11-digit-NDC>~ followed by CTP****<quantity>*<unit>~
fda_ndc_rules.citation: 21 CFR Part 207 (FDA National Drug Code Directory); ASC X12N 005010X222A1 Loop 2410; CMS IOM Pub. 100-04, Ch. 26

florida_medicaid_ahca.agency: Florida Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA)
florida_medicaid_ahca.member_id_rule: 10-digit numeric Florida Medicaid Recipient ID (FMMIS) for FFS and Medicare-Medicaid crossover routing; verify active SMMC MMA/LTC plan enrollment via 270/271.

timely_filing.citation: Florida Administrative Code Rule 59G-1.052 (Florida Medicaid General Policies — Timely Filing)

florida_medicaid_ahca.crossover_cob_rule: Submit primary claim to FCSO Medicare FL (09102). If COBA automatic crossover does not forward to AHCA (77027) or the beneficiary's SMMC MMA/LTC plan, submit secondary 837P with Loop 2320 (SBR*S*18*******MC~, AMT*D, OI) and Loop 2430 (SVD, CAS, DTP*573) matching the Medicare 835 ERA.

qmb_federal_prohibition.rule: Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries (QMBs) are federally protected from ALL Medicare Part A and Part B cost-sharing (deductibles, coinsurance, copayments). Providers — including non-Medicaid-enrolled Medicare providers — are strictly barred from balance-billing QMB patients even when Florida Medicaid pays $0.00 or denies the crossover claim.
qmb_federal_prohibition.citation: Social Security Act § 1902(n)(3)(B) (42 U.S.C. § 1396a(n)(3)(B)); CMS MLN SE1128
